description: In-memory key-value database — strings, hashes, lists, sets, expiration and pub/sub.

redis-cli.title: Open the CLI
redis-cli.description: Opens the interactive client connected to the local Redis (port 6379).
examples: Connects to a host/port with authentication.
warnings: Passing -a <password> can expose the password in shell history.

ping.title: Test connection
ping.description: Checks whether the server responds; returns PONG when healthy.

set.title: Set value
set.description: Writes a string to a key. Options: EX seconds, NX (only if it doesn't exist).
examples: Writes with a 1h TTL only if the key doesn't exist.
arguments: Only sets if the key doesn't exist.

get.title: Get value
get.description: Reads a key's string value; returns nil if it doesn't exist.

incr.title: Increment counter
incr.description: Atomically increments a numeric value; ideal for counters and rate limiting.

del.title: Delete key
del.description: Removes one or more keys. Returns how many were removed.

exists.title: Check existence
exists.description: Returns 1 if the key exists, 0 otherwise.

expire.title: Set expiration
expire.description: Sets a time to live (TTL) in seconds, after which the key is removed.

ttl.title: Check TTL
ttl.description: Returns the seconds remaining until expiration (-1 no TTL, -2 nonexistent).

scan.title: Iterate keys (SCAN)
scan.description: Walks the keyspace incrementally and without blocking. Prefer SCAN over KEYS in production.
arguments: Hint for the count per iteration.
warnings: Avoid KEYS * in production: it blocks the server during the scan.

hset.title: Hash: set fields
hset.description: Writes fields to a hash (object). Use HGETALL to read everything.
examples: Returns all fields and values of the hash.

lpush.title: List: push
lpush.description: Inserts at the head of a list. Combine with RPOP/BRPOP for queues.
examples: Lists all items (0 to the end).

sadd.title: Set: add
sadd.description: Adds unique members to a set. SMEMBERS lists them, SISMEMBER tests membership.
examples: Returns all members of the set.

zadd.title: Sorted set: ranking
zadd.description: Adds members with a score. Ideal for rankings and leaderboards.
examples: Top 10 with scores, from highest to lowest.

subscribe.title: Pub/Sub
subscribe.description: Subscribes to a channel; use PUBLISH channel message on another connection to send.
examples: Publishes a message to the channel.

info.title: Server status
info.description: Returns server metrics: memory, clients, persistence, statistics.

dbsize.title: Number of keys
dbsize.description: Returns the number of keys in the current database.

config-get.title: Read configuration
config-get.description: Reads configuration parameters at runtime (e.g. memory limit).

flushdb.title: Flush current database
flushdb.description: Removes ALL keys from the selected database. Destructive and immediate.
warnings: Deletes all keys in the current database with no confirmation and no undo.

flushall.title: Flush ALL databases
flushall.description: Removes all keys from ALL databases in the instance. Extremely destructive.
warnings: Wipes the ENTIRE instance. Never run in production without absolute certainty.
